Primary focus:

- AI systems using RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, Gemini API, Groq, and structured tool guardrails.
- Full-stack product delivery with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Vercel.

Featured projects:

- DevGuard AI: GitHub App review agent using static analysis, CVE checks, test evidence, and multi-model fallback routing.
- SocraticAI: guided learning assistant using constrained LLM behavior and structured Socratic questioning.
